"""Verify public readiness bytes and all fixed native comparator bindings."""
import hashlib
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v160-paired-response-preparation-v1.json'
output=repo/'docs/results/v160-paired-response-preparation-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
publication=read(index);assert len(publication['copies'])==19 and publication['source_texts']==78
for copy in publication['copies'].values():
    assert ref(copy['original']['path'])==copy['original'] and ref(copy['public']['path'])==copy['public']
    assert Path(copy['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copy['public']['path']).read_bytes()
plan=read(root/'plan-v2.json');guard(plan)
post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json');guard(post)
assert read(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v2.json')['returncode']==0
bundle=read(publication['sources']['path']);assert ref(publication['sources']['path'])==publication['sources']
assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==78 and len(bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'])==87
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for p,h in bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(p)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')
assert smoke['base_compatibility_steps']==10 and smoke['base_compatibility_parameter_gradients']==450
assert smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'ordinary':10,'paired-response':10}
assert read(root/'parity-result-v1.json')['component_forward_evaluations']==56
adoption=read(root/'cache-adoption-v2.json');assert len(adoption['batches'])==23
for item in adoption['batches']:
    assert ref(item['arrays']['path'])==item['arrays'] and ref(item['parent']['path'])==item['parent']
design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json');assert len(design['observations'])==822
assert len(post['retained_native_collections'])==5
arrays=0
for binding in post['retained_native_collections'].values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    collection=read(binding['path']);assert len(collection['observations'])==822
    assert collection['module_before']==collection['module_after'] and collection['RNG_unchanged']
    for row,case in zip(collection['observations'],design['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent']
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction'];arrays+=1
for item in publication['completed_training_input_inspection']['images']:
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original'] and ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
    'docs/paired-response.md','diary/2026-11-07-03-26-40-v160-paired-response.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().is_file(),(name,link)
        links+=1
save(output,{'status':'pass-immutable-preparation-and-fixed-comparator-bindings','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'publication':ref(index),'byte_exact_receipts':19,'source_texts':78,'unchanged_neural_hashes':87,
    'restored_smoke_Adam_states':90,'frozen_base_gradient_tensor_checks':450,
    'adopted_complete_parent_batches':23,'retained_prediction_arrays_checked':arrays,
    'fixed_quality_cases':822,'fixed_endpoints':4,'document_links_checked':links,
    'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Full training and restoration quality remain pending. Actual two-sheet training-input viewing is separate from pending performance-native viewing. Original failure and extra source draw preserved.'})
print('PASS19 exact receipts,78 source texts,87 unchanged neural hashes,23 adopted batches,',arrays,'retained arrays and',links,'links')
